cards.front: What should you know about ablative absolute?
cards.back: A participial construction in the ablative case functioning as a standalone adverbial clause (noun + participle).

cards.front: What should you know about dactylic hexameter?
cards.back: The classical epic metre consisting of six metrical feet (dactyls -uu and spondees --).
